posts.meta_description:
3,813 likes, 39 comments - earthpix on October 21, 2026: "⁠Boulders Beach in South Africa is home to a famous colony of African penguins. 🐧 The sheltered coves have calm water, large granite boulders, and views of the birds as they move between the rocks and sea.⁠
⁠
The colony first arrived here in 1982 and has since become one of Cape Town’s most famous attractions.".

posts.meta_description:
2,884 likes, 27 comments - earthpix on October 21, 2026: "The Dragon Blood Tree, a natural wonder that looks like something from another planet.⁠
Native to Yemen’s Socotra Archipelago, this extraordinary tree releases a deep-red resin when its bark is cut or damaged, giving it its mysterious name. ⁠
⁠
Its unique umbrella-shaped canopy helps it survive in Socotra’s harsh, dry climate by capturing moisture from the air.⁠
Some of these remarkable trees are believed to live for centuries, although their exact lifespan remains uncertain. ⁠
🎥: @thisisranatravels".

4,492 likes, 36 comments - earthpix on October 21, 2026: "Inside Hotel Monteleone in New Orleans’ French Quarter, the Carousel Bar has been slowly turning since 1949. Its 25 seats make one full rotation every 15 minutes, so guests see the room change while they sip.⁠
⁠
The hotel has welcomed literary legends like Ernest Hemingway, Tennessee Williams, and Truman Capote. ⁠
⁠
By: @hotelmonteleone".

posts.meta_description:
3,292 likes, 32 comments - earthpix on October 21, 2026: "Some faces tell a whole life story without saying a word 🤍⁠
⁠
Photographer @nattysingh captures the people behind those stories: a lifetime of sun, sorrow, laughter, and love, written into every line.⁠
⁠
Beyond what we see, there’s a universe of memories, journeys, and experiences that shape who we are, and who we become. ⁠
⁠
In his own words: “One day, if we are lucky, life will write its story across our faces too… of all we loved, all we lost, and everything we somehow survived”.⁠".

3,554 likes, 26 comments - earthpix on October 21, 2026: "This canyon looks like it doesn’t belong on Earth. ⁠
⁠
Socotra, Yemen, is known for some of the most unique nature you’ll find anywhere in the world. Strange, unique trees, white limestone cliffs, turquoise water, and dry valleys all come together across the island.⁠
⁠
It’s the kind of place where every view seems completely different from the last.⁠
⁠
By: @primpaul".

posts.meta_description:
13K likes, 67 comments - earthpix on October 20, 2026: "This lake holds a fifth of the world’s fresh water, and every winter it freezes into something unreal ❄️ ⁠
⁠
Lake Baikal in Siberia is the oldest and deepest lake on Earth, and from late February its ice turns crystal clear. Small guided groups cross a landscape that feels almost cosmic: ice so smooth it mirrors the sky, cliffs coated in frozen splashes, and the famous methane bubbles trapped deep inside.⁠
⁠
As the guides behind these photos say, Baikal’s ice is something you should see with your own eyes at least once in your life.⁠
⁠
Walking on a frozen lake is only safe with experienced local guides who know the ice and how conditions change, so never head out alone.⁠
⁠
By: @andrewk_travel".

posts.meta_description:
4,305 likes, 54 comments - earthpix on October 20, 2026: "What if your dinner menu was decided by tarot cards? 🔮🍽️ At Merlin’s in Ubud, Bali, guests draw cards that guide their food and drink choices, turning a restaurant visit into a unique, interactive experience.⁠
⁠
Beyond the mystical concept, the restaurant serves creative dishes with thoughtful presentation, proving that the experience is about more than just the surprise of not knowing what’s coming next. ⁠
⁠
Would you let the cards choose your entire meal?⁠
🎥: @twosolesabroad".

posts.meta_description:
4,666 likes, 67 comments - earthpix on October 20, 2026: "Le Procope opened in 1686 and is often called the oldest café in Paris. ⁠
⁠
Over the centuries, it welcomed Voltaire, Rousseau, Victor Hugo, and, according to legend, a young Napoleon who couldn’t settle his bill!⁠
⁠
Instead of cash, he left his hat… and never came back for it. Today, the hat is still on display by the entrance.⁠
⁠
By: @restaurantprocope1686".
